title: Deep learning on histopathology adds prognostic value beyond AJCC stage in melanoma
summary: An end-to-end deep-learning model on H&E whole-slide images was developed in a 328-patient discovery case-control set (best-fold balanced accuracy 0.88) and evaluated in a separate population-based cohort of 266 patients. It was an independent prognostic factor (adjusted OR 1.97), and the C-index rose from 0.80 for AJCC stage alone to 0.87 when combined. The matched case-control design and preprint status limit conclusions.
ai_technology: End-to-end deep learning on whole-slide histopathology images
